title: SCOPE: Source Credibility and Outlet Profiling Engine
abstract: arXiv:2610.35929v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present SCOPE, a multi-agent system for profiling news media outlets with respect to bias, factuality, and credibility. Given an outlet URL, SCOPE coordinates specialized agents for article acquisition, content analysis, external evidence search, scoring, and report generation. The system follows an MBFC-style methodology while making intermediate evidence and agent outputs inspectable through a structured demonstration interface. On a benchmark of 200 media outlets, SCOPE outperforms LLM-only, article-only, search-only, and media-background-check baselines on most metrics, achieving the lowest bias and factuality MAE, perfect failed-fact-check detection, and the lowest factual error rate. These results suggest that decomposed, evidence-grounded agent workflows can support more transparent and reliable media profiling. Our code is available at https://github.com/mbaisbay/SCOPE, and a live demonstration at https://scope-demo.streamli

translated_title: SCOPE：信源可信度与媒体机构画像引擎
translated_abstract: 我们提出了SCOPE，一个用于对新闻媒体机构在偏见、事实性和可信度方面进行画像的多智能体系统。给定一个媒体机构的URL，SCOPE会协调多个专门的智能体来完成文章获取、内容分析、外部证据搜索、评分和报告生成等任务。该系统遵循MBFC（媒体偏见事实核查）风格的方法论，同时通过结构化的演示界面使中间证据和智能体输出可供查验。在一个包含200家媒体机构的基准测试中，SCOPE在大多数指标上优于仅使用大语言模型、仅使用文章、仅使用搜索以及媒体背景核查等基线方法，实现了最低的偏见和事实性平均绝对误差（MAE）、完美的失败事实核查检测能力以及最低的事实错误率。这些结果表明，分解式的、基于证据的智能体工作流能够支持更透明、更可靠的媒体画像。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/mbaisbay/SCOPE 获取，在线演示见 https://scope-demo.streamli
tldr: 本文提出SCOPE多智能体系统，通过协调文章获取、内容分析、证据搜索等专门智能体，基于证据对新闻媒体的偏见、事实性和可信度进行透明评估，在200家媒体基准上超越了多种基线方法。
en_tdlr: This paper presents SCOPE, a multi-agent system that profiles news media outlets' bias, factuality, and credibility through decomposed, evidence-grounded agent workflows, outperforming multiple baselines on a benchmark of 200 media outlets.
